## Description and Rationale

I am a solo participant with a background in aeronautical engineering (BSc, Istanbul Technical University), now at ETH Zurich, and I registered for this challenge to apply machine learning to real-world European air traffic data and contribute an open, reproducible taxi-out prediction model to the aviation research community.

## Details

* Type: Academia
* Country: Turkey
* Number of team members: 1
